jokes.title: Best Version
jokes.text: I lost a bet and had to attend a seminar called “Achieve Your Potential.” The speaker told us to imagine the best version of ourselves. Mine was at home, because he hadn’t lost the bet.

jokes.title: The Bet
jokes.text: I lost a bet to my buddy and had to tell people I'm an inventor for a week. Worst week of my life. Guy at a party goes, "Oh cool, what have you invented?" I panicked and said "the fitted sheet." He just stared at me. I said "the good news is I'm still working on the instructions."

jokes.title: Aggressive Brunch
jokes.text: I get weirdly defensive in bakeries. The teenager at the counter asked if my dozen eclairs were for a special occasion. I immediately crossed my arms and snapped, "They're for a party." He looked at my sweatpants and said, "At 8 AM on a Tuesday?" I stared him down and said, "It's a very aggressive brunch, Kevin, just box the pastries and mind your own business."

jokes.title: Bakery Shift Forfeit
jokes.text: I lost a bet last week, so the forfeit was working a full shift at my buddy's bakery. Morning rush, this guy storms in complaining his croissant is too flaky. I look at him and say, "Sir, I lost a bet to be standing here covered in flour at 6 a.m. Your pastry is the least of our issues."

jokes.title: Defensive Dough
jokes.text: I walked into a bakery the other day and asked if they had anything fresh. The baker got super defensive, like, “Everything here is fresh!” I’m thinking, relax, man, I’m not the croissant police. But he kept going, so I finally said, “Look, I just want a muffin, not a sworn affidavit.”
